      Phin Lounge An Bang — Garden Restaurant Near An Bang Beach

      Vietnamese coffee, breakfast, lunch, dinner and wine in our leafy garden, just a short walk from An Bang Beach.

      A Relaxed Garden Restaurant Near An Bang Beach

      Just a short walk from An Bang Beach, Phin Lounge is our relaxed garden café and restaurant — a place to start the day with breakfast and Vietnamese coffee, settle in for lunch, or come back for dinner and cocktails.

      Our menu brings together Vietnamese favourites, breakfast and brunch, and our own Phin creations, with plenty of space to slow down after the beach.

      Upstairs, you’ll also find Phin Flow Yoga, making Phin Lounge a little different from our other Hoi An locations.

      Coffee • Breakfast & Brunch • Lunch • Dinner • Wine • Garden

      Visit Phin Lounge An Bang

      Address: End of Alley, 128 Nguyễn Phan Vinh, An Bang, Hoi An

      Good to Know: Short walk from An Bang Beach · Leafy garden · Breakfast, lunch & dinner · Cocktails · Upstairs coffee class room & yoga studio

      PHỞ VỊT XÔNG KHÓI · 120,000

      SMOKED DUCK NOODLE

      The story of Pho begins at the end of the 19th century when the first version of Pho, Pho Bo (Beef Pho), was served by local vendors with mobile kitchens around the Old Quarter of Hanoi. The wave of migration to the South by 1945 then created the Southern Pho style, along with various styles of Pho in each province and even in their own kitchens.

      Our Smoked Duck Pho, Pho Vit Xong Khoi, is prepared by our young, passionate chefs using traditional cooking methods: slow-cooked duck bones with roasted pineapple, ginger, and onion for a savory duck broth, served with fresh Pho noodles and our delicious smoked duck breast. A perfect bowl of Pho at any time of day!

      HỘI AN SPECIALTIES

      Hội An was an important trading port during the 15th and 16th centuries, leading to an influx of Chinese, Japanese, and European traders and merchants. These new residents brought their own culinary traditions, combining them with local ingredients to create some unique dishes.

      CAO LAU
      Cao Lau is a special noodle unique to Hoi An. These rice noodles are in charcoal lye water, bringing a special flavor and color. These noodles were invented around the 15th century when Hoi An was a popular trading port for Portuguese, Dutch, Italian, French, British, Chinese, Japanese, and Vietnamese locals.

      Saigon Cider · 85,000

      Apple & Ginger
      Invigorating fusion of apple & zesty, hand-pressed, fresh Vietnamese ginger. Medium-sweet, low-tannin, sparkling, with a light, crisp body.
      Fish and chicken dishes pair well with this tart, spiced explosion of flavours.
      4.7% ABV / 330 ml bottles
      Apple & Chilli
      Apple with a touch of spice from hand-pressed, fresh Vietnamese chilli. Medium-sweet, low tannin, sparkling, with a light, crisp body.
      Adds a tantalizing bite alongside seafood, sizzling plates, barbeque and fried crispy dishes.
      4.0% ABV / 330 ml bottles
      ORIGINAL APPLE
      From a delightful blend of Fuji, Gala and other favourite apples.  Medium-sweet, low-tannin, sparkling, with a light, crisp body.
      Delicately seasoned dishes such as slow-roasted crispy pork belly, sushi, or lighter vegetarian dishes, pair well well with this crisp, clean cider.
      4.7% ABV / 330ml bottles

      From Breakfast to Evening at An Bang

      Mornings at Phin Lounge start with Vietnamese coffee, breakfast and brunch in the garden. With An Bang Beach just a short walk away, it’s an easy place to begin the day before heading to the sea.

      Later, settle in for lunch or dinner with Vietnamese favourites and our own Phin creations. Our wine cellar brings together a selection of wines chosen to enjoy with the food

      Come straight from the beach, find a shady table in the garden and stay a little longer.

      Breakfast & Brunch • Lunch • Dinner • Coffee • Wine

      Vietnamese Coffee Experiences at An Bang

      Upstairs at Phin Lounge, our dedicated coffee class room is a relaxed space to explore Vietnamese coffee with our team.

      Join our Easy Vietnamese Coffee Class at 2:00 PM for a hands-on introduction to traditional brewing and some of Vietnam’s best-known coffee drinks.

      For guests who want to go deeper, our Vietnamese Coffee Master Class at 9:00 AM explores Vietnamese coffee in more detail, from beans and brewing to tasting and preparation.

      Easy Class · 2:00 PM · 1 Hour
      Master Class · 9:00 AM · 2 Hours

      EXPLORE COFFEE EXPERIENCES

      Phin Flow Yoga at An Bang

      Upstairs at Phin Lounge, Phin Flow Yoga offers a peaceful space to practise just a short walk from An Bang Beach.

      Join a morning yoga class, then come downstairs for Vietnamese coffee, breakfast or brunch in the garden — an easy way to enjoy a slower start to the day in An Bang.
